fields.help_en:
The tag key used to perform an exact search for Elastic scaling resources. Valid values of tag key length: 1 to 128.

`Tags` is used to perform an exact search for Elastic scaling resources that have the specified tags bound. Each tag is a key-value pair.
If you specify only `Tags.Key`, all resources associated with the tag key are returned.
If you specify only `Tags.Value`, the `MissingParameter.TagKey` error is returned.
If you specify multiple tag key-value pairs at the same time, only Elastic scaling resources that match all the specified tag key-value pairs are returned
fields.help_zh:
精确查找弹性伸缩资源时使用的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~128。

`Tags`用于精确查找绑定了指定标签的弹性伸缩资源，由一个键值对组成。
仅指定`Tags.Key`时，则返回关联该标签键的所有资源。
仅指定`Tags.Value`时，则出现`MissingParameter.TagKey`的报错提示。
同时指定多个标签键值对时，仅同时满足所有标签键值对的弹性伸缩资源会被查找到
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. This parameter is optional and can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。非必填，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或者```https://```

NValue.description_en: The data request range of the alert rule condition, in minutes. For example, NValue=5 indicates that the alert requests data from the last 5 minutes every minute
NValue.description_zh: 报警规则判断条件的数据请求范围，单位为分钟。例如，NValue=5表示每分钟报警将请求最近5分钟的数据

Operator.description_en:
The comparison operator of the alert rule condition. Valid values:

CURRENT_GTE: greater than or equal to
CURRENT_LTE: less than or equal to
PREVIOUS_UP: increase percentage compared with the previous period
PREVIOUS_DOWN: decrease percentage compared with the previous period
HOH_UP: increase percentage compared with the same time in the previous hour
HOH_DOWN: decrease percentage compared with the same time in the previous hour
DOD_UP: increase percentage compared with the same time on the previous day
DOD_DOWN: decrease percentage compared with the same time on the previous day
Operator.description_zh:
报警规则判断条件的判断符号：

CURRENT_GTE：大于或等于
CURRENT_LTE：小于或等于
PREVIOUS_UP：环比上升百分比
PREVIOUS_DOWN：环比下降百分比
HOH_UP：与上小时同比上升百分比
HOH_DOWN：与上小时同比下降百分比
DOD_UP：与昨日同比上升百分比
DOD_DOWN：与昨日同比下降百分比

Config.description_en:
The configuration items of the alert rule, in JSON string format.

Valid values of continuous:

`true`: An alert notification is sent every minute.
`false`: The alert silence period is enabled.

dataRevision specifies the data revision policy when no data is obtained or the data is null. Valid values:
  
`0`: Zero filling.
`1`: Fill with 1.
`2`: Fill with null (default). The data is not processed, and no alert event is generated when no data is available
Config.description_zh:
报警规则的配置项，格式为JSON字符串。

continuous的值包括：

`true`：每分钟均发送报警
`false`：打开报警静默期开关

dataRevision表示未取得数据或者或数据为null值时的数据修订策略，包括：
  
`0`：补零策略。
`1`：补一策略。
`2`：补null （默认补null），将不对数据做处理，无数据时将不会生成报警事件

Dimensions.description_en: The dimension conditions in the alert rule
Dimensions.description_zh: 报警规则判断条件中的维度条件

Key.description_en:
The name of the dimension. Valid values:

`rpc`: the interface name
`rpcType`: the interface call type, such as HTTP or DUBBO
`endpoint`: the database name
`rootIp`: the IP address of the host
Key.description_zh:
维度名称，包括以下值：

`rpc`：接口名称
`rpcType`：接口调用类型（如HTTP、DUBBO）
`endpoint`：数据库名称
`rootIp`：机器IP地址

Type.description_en:
The type of the dimension condition. Valid values:

`STATIC`: fixed match. You must specify dimensions.value for this dimension value.
`ALL`: traverses all dimension values. The metrics of all interface names are evaluated in sequence. The interface that triggers the threshold is displayed in the alert content. You do not need to specify dimensions.value.
`DISABLE`: aggregates all dimension values into a single value (sum). You do not need to specify dimensions.value
Type.description_zh:
维度条件的类型，包含以下可选值：

`STATIC`： 固定匹配此维度值需要填dimensions.value。
`ALL`：遍历所有维度值，按此接口所有接口名的指标依次判断，哪个接口触发阈值引起报警，就会在报警内容中体现该接口名，此时不需要填dimensions.value。
`DISABLE`：聚合所有维度值为一个值（求和），此时不需要填dimensions.value

Value.description_en: The value of the dimension option

Pid.description_zh: 报警规则关联的应用的ID

`txn_type`: Application Monitoring call type statistics

`jvm`: JVM monitoring
`host`: host monitoring

Type.description_zh:

`txn`：应用监控入口调用量
`txn_type`：应用监控调用类型统计
`db`：数据库指标
`jvm`：JVM监控

EndTime.description_en: The timestamp of the end time of the effective period of the alert rule. This parameter controls the effective period of the alert rule within each 24-hour day. The format is a UNIX timestamp. The year, month, and day in the timestamp do not take effect. Only the hour, minute, and second take effect
EndTime.description_zh: 报警规则生效时间范围的结束时间的时间戳，控制报警规则在每天24小时中的生效时间范围。格式为UNIX时间戳，其中年月日不生效，只有时分秒生效

NoticeEndTime.description_en: The timestamp of the end time of the notification time range of the alert rule. This parameter controls the notification time range within a 24-hour period each day. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Only the hour, minute, and second parts take effect. The year, month, and day parts are ignored
NoticeEndTime.description_zh: 报警规则通知时间范围的结束时间的时间戳，控制报警规则在每天24小时中的通知时间范围。格式为UNIX时间戳，其中年月日不生效，只有时分秒生效

NoticeStartTime.description_en: The timestamp of the start time of the notification time range of the alert rule. This parameter controls the notification time range within a 24-hour period each day. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Only the hour, minute, and second parts take effect. The year, month, and day parts are ignored
NoticeStartTime.description_zh: 报警规则通知时间范围的开始时间的时间戳，控制报警规则在每天24小时中的通知时间范围。格式为UNIX时间戳，其中年月日不生效，只有时分秒生效

StartTime.description_en: The timestamp of the start time of the effective period of the alert rule. This parameter controls the effective period of the alert rule within each 24-hour day. The format is a UNIX timestamp. The year, month, and day in the timestamp do not take effect. Only the hour, minute, and second take effect
StartTime.description_zh: 报警规则生效时间范围的开始时间的时间戳，控制报警规则在每天24小时中的生效时间范围。格式为UNIX时间戳，其中年月日不生效，只有时分秒生效
